title: Crescent Gang
description:
Crescent Gang
When a young girl is placed into foster care, she moves to Crescent Street, where she meets other kids from the system.  When they learn that the house is being sold and they will have to move once again and be separated, they search for a solution and meet  an attorney, herself a product of the system, finding that there's always help and hope for those daring enough to seek it.
